summary: Scope 03 durable-storage evidence after PRs #164 to #172 landed: the Zstd body stop passed as the parse stop (#164), the std-only storage_io fault seam and crash sweep under D30 (#165), the TypeScript write sequence with syncs in order, torn-tail repair, rollback and retry, and a Win32 write-through publication (#167), the D31 cross-runtime resume check (#168), Cargo caching and kept Rust logs in CI (#170), migration publication's source check, published-target inspection, and reselection under the lock with competing and interrupted migrations checked across runtimes (#171), and the Zstd writer whose frames equal Node's byte for byte (#172). A clean checkout of candidate 96a4856be4fc83f99fc2b5b230d9fac71f20681e passed 522 workspace Cargo tests (24 ignored by default), cargo fmt, clippy, and rustdoc, the ignored full torn-write fault sweep, the ignored full deepened sweeps of bake-session and bake-cli, 4502 Vitest tests (8 skipped) in the 45 TypeScript specs that read the 41 shared case tables (3721 cases), and the 33 cross-runtime lease and resume cases between real TypeScript and Rust processes. CI for PR #172 tested synthetic merge 1641de74c6fb415d2d25242d02c6e56b205a2c53, which has the candidate's tree 34e646b1c57cc355536a80305f9a6b66083acff7, and passed the native jobs on Linux, macOS, and Windows, the runtime job, and the app-check job. One flipped Zstd fault-case expectation was rejected by both harnesses. The native-limit classification holds 109 limits: 101 unreachable, 8 reachable gaps accepted by D26 and D28, none undecided. Query, cache, and indexing, released TypeScript tags as writers, Windows-host runs of most specs, and full preflight are missing. Not scope acceptance.

results.behavior: All 45 TypeScript specs under packages/ that read a conformance/session or conformance/runtime table, other than the opt-in cross-runtime spec, passed in 4.5 s: 4502 Vitest tests passed and 8 skipped, the cases gated to win32, darwin, or case-insensitive volumes on this Linux host. Among them are the storage fault (v3, 137 cases), plain-log-file (v12, 109 cases), migration-publication (v1, 15 cases), and Zstd frame (v1, 13 cases) specs, whose Zstd trees and frames the specs check against Node's libzstd 1.5.7. Counts describe Vitest tests across 45 files, not table cases.

cargo test --workspace --locked passed 522 tests across 64 test targets (5 doc-test targets ran none) in 65.6 s, with 24 ignored by default: 17 million-level depth tests, the deepened full sweeps with their child tests, the million-level lookup test, and full_torn_write_sweep. fault_cases passed its crash, power-cut, and failure sweep over 13 scenarios under the POSIX and Win32 sequences, the double-failure test, and every shared fault case; migration_publication_cases, plain_log_file_cases, zstd_cases, and lease_probe (12 tests) passed. Most integration tests iterate a whole table inside one test, so counts describe Cargo tests, not cases.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, and rustdoc with -Dwarnings for bake-session and bake-cli exited 0. Each count is one command, not a test.

The ignored full_torn_write_sweep, which tears every write of every fault scenario at every byte count on both platform sequences, passed in 19.5 s; the ignored deepened_cases_full_sweep passed in 192.6 s and deepened_cli_full_sweep in 57.1 s. Each is one Cargo test; durations are wall-clock on a 32-thread host with warm build caches, not a performance baseline.

bun run test:rust:lease passed all 33 cases in 5.3 s, between the built TypeScript backend and the bake-session-lease-probe binary as real processes: 9 lease cases (exclusion both ways, takeover after release or a killed holder, a stopped holder) and 24 resume cases (each runtime resuming a plain or Zstd log the other wrote or left torn when killed, v0 to v2 sources migrated by either runtime to identical bytes or frames, concurrent and interrupted migrations, a stopped migrating writer, and a read-only Session directory). Every case compares exact bytes, hashes older generations, and lists the Session directory. Counts describe Vitest tests.

docs/roadmap/rust-0.4/scope-02/native-limits.json (sha256 in the fixture manifest) classifies 109 native limits against D21, covering 317 limit cases in 34 tables: 101 unreachable (313 cases) and 8 reachable gaps (4 cases), none undecided. Since the previous record, zstd/stop-order was ported (#164), and migration/target-tail (#171) and zstd-plaintext-budget (#172) were added as unreachable. The reachable gaps are owner exceptions D26 and D28. native_limit_classification.rs passed inside cargo-test; it proves the table complete and consistent, not that a classification is right.

On PR #172's synthetic merge 1641de74c6fb415d2d25242d02c6e56b205a2c53 (candidate tree), native preflight passed 5 gates on Linux and macOS (rust, rust-pty, rust-conformance, rust-eval, rust-lease) and 4 on Windows with rust-pty skipped (native ConPTY scenarios are not implemented). The rust gate runs cargo test without --ignored; on Windows hosts the fault and deepened sweeps sample their points. The rust-lease gate ran the cross-runtime specs on all three hosts, and on Windows MoveFileExW publication ran for real. Counts describe gates.

The rust jobs then ran seven of the conformance specs (lookup, generation-header, stat, list, v2-to-v3 migration, subagent projection and catalog) on each OS: 854 passed and 4 skipped on Linux, 849 and 9 on macOS, 817 and 41 on Windows. Counts describe Vitest tests across those seven files.
The same run's runtime job passed the build, runtime (whole suite), and integration gates on Linux at the candidate tree. Counts describe gates.

App checks with --full --skip runtime,native passed 27 gates and skipped 9 on Linux, including typecheck, lint, verify-persistence-catalog, verify-rust-migration-inventory, the ledger verifier, tui-spec, and e2e; whitespace (no merge base), actionlint, and the seven runtime and native gates skipped by flag were the skips. Counts describe gates.
Local runs of the specs, cargo test, the cross-runtime check, and the ignored sweeps on Windows and macOS.

missingEvidence.what: Zstd v1 sources, large migration frames, and partly durable bytes
missingEvidence.reason: Zstd v1 sources are covered only by the plain-log-file table; migration frames match Node's only for small sources, since TypeScript pipes them through createZstdCompress; no power cut keeps part of a file's unsynced bytes.

The fault model assumes a write-through move flushes the NTFS metadata journal; Rust passes MoveFileExW paths without toNamespacedPath; macOS sync_dir uses F_FULLFSYNC without libuv's fallbacks. None is tested on a real power loss.
No Agent resumes and no composed runtime runs over the Rust writer; the writer and probe are development-only.
